snippet.title: Open For Business - Video and Game Store Simulator
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3919690/OPEN_FOR_BUSINESS
Build your own game & movie store — from retro VHS tapes to modern consoles. 
Fill your shelves with games, movies, and collectibles, attract customers, and grow your business into the ultimate entertainment shop — all while reliving the nostalgia of iconic eras.
